Enemy descriptionAn elite Landbreaker warbeast enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular ripptusk is more ferocious and cunning, and attacks with less predictable moves.

enemies.name: Ereignis
enemies.summary:
Ereignis is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionWhat is the meaning of progress? What constitutes meaning? What is the nature of life?

enemies.name: Falsewings
enemies.summary:
Falsewings is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Psuthopteron" (archive ID: ARA07C) has flight capabilities that are wholly unrelated to its morphology. This pattern was originally regarded as biomimicry. However, the modern consensus believes it was a mimic of Terran flying...

enemies.name: Falsewings α
enemies.summary:
Falsewings α is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Psuthopteron Anavon" (archive ID: ARA07Cα) is an energized variant of the ARA07C. Most observers regard color as the only differentiating feature between the Anavon and the basic variants.

enemies.name: Firemist Originium Slug
enemies.summary:
Firemist Originium Slug is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA wild creature infected by Originium with extremely high body temperatures. This slug explodes when near death, covering everything nearby with acidic body fluids at boiling temperatures as well as active Originium dust...

enemies.name: Fortune's Stash
enemies.summary:
Fortune's Stash is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn apparition enlightened by Si. A fortune saved is generosity ensured. With wealth in hand is light secured.

enemies.name: Glaring Rakerbeast
enemies.summary:
Glaring Rakerbeast is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA rakerbeast variant featuring a different colored coat, shorter lifespan, but greater strength. Its eyes seem to glow like liquid fire.

enemies.name: Gloomwald's Rage
enemies.summary:
Gloomwald's Rage is an Alpha enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA giant battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. It had taken its master's command to roam and scour the boundless realm of mist until the moment when it realized that it was abandoned, until it became the vessel bearing the...

enemies.name: Grove Archer
enemies.summary:
Grove Archer is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn armed outlaw equipped with basic ranged weaponry. Trained in the bamboo groves, the outlaw can fire an arrow through the forest without hitting a single leaf blade.

enemies.name: Hazefyre Axe Armorbeast

names.es: Bestia armadura con hacha de bruma ardiente

enemies.summary:
Hazefyre Axe Armorbeast is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn axe armorbeast corrupted by hazefyre. The creature has become extremely aggressive, having been driven into a state of rabid insanity. Approach with caution if you do not intend to be split in half by its "great axe...

enemies.name: Hazefyre Claw

names.ja: 霧火ランドブレーカー

enemies.summary:
Hazefyre Claw is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA Landbreaker combatant corrupted by hazefyre. Absorbing hazefyre should not be regarded as a fortunate blessing. These raiders have become horribly twisted versions of their former selves.

enemies.name: Hazefyre Tuskbeast
enemies.summary:
Hazefyre Tuskbeast is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA tuskbeast corrupted by hazefyre. These small aberrations usually move in packs and can pose a serious threat, even to fully armed field teams.

enemies.name: Heavy Ram
enemies.summary:
Heavy Ram is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Thrylissoron" (archive ID: ACL072) is a non-standard variant of ACL071. It can manipulate its environment and make tactical decisions.

enemies.name: Heavy Ram α
enemies.summary:
Heavy Ram α is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Thrylissoron Anavon" (archive ID: ACL072α) is an energized variant of ACL072. Its high energy contents did not affect its decision-making abilities. This entity is extremely dangerous.

enemies.name: Heavy Sting
enemies.summary:
Heavy Sting is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Varykentron" (archive ID: ARL141) is a non-standard variant of ARL121. It would occasionally perform whip attacks with its tail instead of using its ranged energy attack.

enemies.name: Heavy Sting α
enemies.summary:
Heavy Sting α is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Varykentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL141α) is an energized variant of ARL141 that has retained a plethora of attack patterns. It is a tougher and more dangerous entity.

enemies.name: Hedron
enemies.summary:
Hedron is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Diaphaistagran" (archive ID: ARM315) is a fluid-based pattern with energy projecting capabilities. Its shape is that of a complex yet symmetrical geometry. Its attacks can also sap heat from any surface they come in contact with.

enemies.name: Hedron δ
enemies.summary:
Hedron δ is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Diaphaistagran Dinedon" (archive ID: ARM315δ) is an energized variant of ARM315. When irradiated by sunlight, it gives off a shimmering purple light. However, it assumes a different form when irradiated by light reflecting off Talos...

enemies.name: Highway Reaver
enemies.summary:
Highway Reaver is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn armed criminal active in Wuling territories. They would usually set up illegal road barricades or engage in the smuggling of illegal goods. Some of them would even attack travelers.

enemies.name: Hill Smasher
enemies.summary:
Hill Smasher is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA criminal armed with a heavy weapon. The name may sound like an exaggerated joke, but the Hill Smasher's quadruple rocket launcher delivers serious firepower. Do not underestimate this foe.

enemies.name: Imbued Quillbeast
enemies.summary:
Imbued Quillbeast is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA quillbeast infected by active Originium dust. The creature's spines are imbued with high levels of energy, making them extremely destructive.

enemies.name: Indigenous Pincerbeast
enemies.summary:
Indigenous Pincerbeast is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA wild creature infected by Originium. The large beast carries multiple Originium clusters and is capable of ripping apart its prey with its sickle-like frontal limbs.

enemies.name: Maned Measure
enemies.summary:
Maned Measure is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn apparition enlightened by Si. Curves and lines, measured and fine. An enlightened pursuit, as decreed up high.

enemies.name: Marble Aggelomoirai (palecore)
enemies.summary:
Marble Aggelomoirai (palecore) is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield. Alternate form(s): Marble Aggelomoirai (palesent)
Enemy descriptionNO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been classified as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Though its morphic modules were re-assembled, the entity continues...

enemies.name: Marble Aggelomoirai (palesent)
enemies.summary:
Marble Aggelomoirai (palesent) is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield. Alternate form(s): Marble Aggelomoirai (palecore)
Enemy descriptionNO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been categorized as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Its outward appearance mimics that of Nefarith. Despite its high core...

enemies.name: Marble Appendage
enemies.summary:
Marble Appendage is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionNO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been classified as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Its physical manifestation would appear like extensions reaching out from its main body. However, these appendages actually reach into...

enemies.name: Mudflow
enemies.summary:
Mudflow is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Tholeroygran" (archive ID: ACM311) is the first fluid-based pattern to be discovered. The morphology of the halo is unstable and the internal temperature is typically lower than its constituent materials.

enemies.name: Mudflow δ
enemies.summary:
Mudflow δ is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Tholeroygran Dinedon" (archive ID: ACM311δ) is an energized variant of ACM311. It utilizes unique energy pathways and thus maintains a homeostatic temperature significantly below the freezing points of its constituent matter.

enemies.name: Nefarith, "Bonekrusher"

names.ja: 「ボーンクラッシャー」ネファリス

enemies.summary:
Nefarith, "Bonekrusher" is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThanks to Nefarith, the "Bonekrushers" became a byword for terror in the Civilization Band. Her brutal conquest has not yet ended, and her true ambitions have not yet been revealed.

enemies.name: Nefarith, "Conqueror"
enemies.summary:
Nefarith, "Conqueror" is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe Conqueror's inner perception of herself. She does not hide her desire to lay waste to Civilization.

enemies.name: Nimbus Razor
enemies.summary:
Nimbus Razor is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA criminal armed with a strange weapon. When the Cloud Stalker is tired of using the strange lantern, he would draw his short blade and engage in melee combat.

enemies.name: Prism
enemies.summary:
Prism is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Prismastagran" (archive ID: ASM316) is a non-model variant of ARM315. It is capable of protecting nearby Aggeloi, and is very difficult to hit as it often surrounds itself with ARM315 entities.

enemies.name: Quillbeast
enemies.summary:
Quillbeast is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA wild quillbeast indigenous to Talos-II. When it raises its quills and starts rolling around, it becomes as destructive as a spinning chainsaw.

enemies.name: Quillbeast Blightshade
enemies.summary:
Quillbeast Blightshade is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a quillbeast. This blightshade seems to exhibit far more aggressive rolling and bouncing attacks than its living counterpart, though it may just...

enemies.name: Rakerbeast Blightshade
enemies.summary:
Rakerbeast Blightshade is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a rakerbeast. The eye-spotted coat seems more fluid and highlights attack moves that are truly terrifying to behold.

enemies.name: Ram
enemies.summary:
Ram is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Kriosson" (archive ID: ACL071) is amongst the earliest recorded form of the Aggeloi and the most commonly encountered. It attacks by ramming its victims with its horns.

enemies.name: Ram α
enemies.summary:
Ram α is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Kriosson Anavon" (archive ID: ACL071α) is an energized variant of ACL071. The entity's excessive energy content gives it a characteristic bright red appearance and makes it stronger and faster than the standard variant.

enemies.name: Rhodagn the Bonekrushing Fist

names.ja: 「ボーンクラッシャーの拳」ロダン

enemies.summary:
Rhodagn the Bonekrushing Fist is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe right fist of Nefarith and the most feared Bonekrusher soldier of the clan. Many Landbreakers had challenged Nefarith's leadership, only to be utterly crushed by Rhodagn's fists.

enemies.name: Road Plunderer
enemies.summary:
Road Plunderer is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn armed criminal active in the jurisdiction of Wuling City. Road Plunderers would usually set up illegal road barricades or engage in the smuggling of illegal goods. Eliminating these brigands is a top priority for the law enforcement...

enemies.name: Rockhowler
enemies.summary:
Rockhowler is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionRockhowlers can live in the natural wilderness. These intelligent yet mischievous creatures often prepare "traps" and "dangers" for hapless travelers. They seem to enjoy the sight of humans frustrated by their antics. Please deal with...

enemies.name: Ruan Yi
enemies.summary:
Ruan Yi is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionRuan Yi had kept his anger in check for years. When a fleeting "opportunity" presented itself, he decided it was time to finally unleash his pent-up fury.

enemies.name: Scroll of Tactics
enemies.summary:
Scroll of Tactics is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn apparition enlightened by Si. Master of battle, no stranger to deception. Bearer of arms, and defender of peace.

enemies.name: Sentinel
enemies.summary:
Sentinel is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Phrourossaron" (ARS316) is a suspected Aggeloid attempt at mimicking the shape and attack patterns of humanity's sentry guns. Despite its massive range, the Sentinel is a sessile organism.

enemies.name: Si/Enemy
enemies.summary:
Si is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionCreek of spring thaw, slopes of red fall, old dreams ebb as new life soars.

enemies.name: Simmer's Purge
enemies.summary:
Simmer's Purge is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn apparition enlightened by Si. Creator of clouds from which rains burst. Solver of troubles, and purger of thirst.

enemies.name: Skydrummer
enemies.summary:
Skydrummer is an Alpha enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA howlerbeast that grew up in the wilderness. This beast is indigenous to Talos-II. Strong membranes on its head and neck allow it to unleash powerful howling loud enough to shake the hills and forests.

enemies.name: Spotted Rakerbeast
enemies.summary:
Spotted Rakerbeast is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA rakerbeast that grew up in the wilderness. These apex predators are endemic to Talos-II. They can leap great distances and attack their prey with razor sharp claws.

enemies.name: Sting
enemies.summary:
Sting is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Kentron" (archive ID: ARL121) would charge pieces of itself with energy and propel them with inertial launching. The energy efficiency of this mechanism is extremely low.

enemies.name: Sting α
enemies.summary:
Sting α is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Kentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL121α) is an energized variant of ARL121. The entity's higher energy density gives it greater firepower. The energy efficiency of its firing mechanism remains low.

enemies.name: Sweeping Wind
enemies.summary:
Sweeping Wind is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA criminal armed with basic ranged weaponry. Keen sight and dexterous hands allow for deadly shots. This Wind would blow through buildings to sweep all the valuables away.

enemies.name: Tidalklast
enemies.summary:
Tidalklast is an Alpha enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Anavatklydan" (archive ID: AGM32L) is a non-model variant of AGM321. Such entities come in a wide range of sizes. The sight of particularly large individuals breaking out of the water has become a nightmare for those who witnessed...

enemies.name: Tidewalker
enemies.summary:
Tidewalker is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Genesklydan" (archive ID: AGM321) exhibits humanoid head and legs. Ever since the discovery of this particular pattern, human resemblance became an unspoken rule for assessing Aggeloid threat levels.

enemies.name: Tidewalker δ
enemies.summary:
Tidewalker δ is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Genesklydan Dinedon" (archive ID: AGM321δ) is an energized variant of AGM321. Its constituent matter is in a constant, turbulent flow. This also explains its particularly terrifying form when it appears at night.

enemies.name: Triaggelos
enemies.summary:
Triaggelos is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionNO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been classified as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Changes to its halo may reflect its ability to make tactical decisions. Be warned. Ankhor-like properties have been detected in this entity...

enemies.name: Tunneling Nidwyrm
enemies.summary:
Tunneling Nidwyrm is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA creature that spews highly corrosive fluids. Nidwyrms usually live underground. They would dissolve metallic materials with acids before consuming them. Nidwyrm hunters are therefore advised to take proper care of their...

enemies.name: Tuskbeast Blightshade
enemies.summary:
Tuskbeast Blightshade is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a tuskbeast. Although this is but a "lingering shadow", its sharp fangs are still capable of tearing through armor and protective gear.

enemies.name: Walking Chrysopolis
enemies.summary:
Walking Chrysopolis is an Alpha enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Thureoron" (archive ID: ACL156) is a pattern furnished with a shield-like structure that protects its halo. Be warned. This Aggelos can manipulate energy to drag distant targets towards itself.

enemies.name: Waterlamp
enemies.summary:
Waterlamp is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA wild arthropod that lives in aquatic environments. The waterlamp gives off a faint glow and its body fluids contain irritants that may induce allergic reactions and even burns. Be careful when tackling this creature.

enemies.name: Wild Tuskbeast
enemies.summary:
Wild Tuskbeast is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionWild tuskbeasts are predators of the Talosian wilderness. Given the hostile environments of Talos-II, getting to the top of the food chain is no small feat.

enemies.name: Woodcraft Slug
enemies.summary:
Woodcraft Slug is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. Its shape resembles that of the Originium Slug. This woodcraft can move quickly and is an excellent burrower.

enemies.name: Woodcraft Wanderer
enemies.summary:
Woodcraft Wanderer is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA small battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. It is in charge of keeping the Snowy Forest safe. Do not underestimate its fists of wood, for they can smash through stone with hardly any effort.

enemies.name: YSTF Captain Blightshade

names.es: Sombra contaminada de capitán del EFEY

enemies.summary:
YSTF Captain Blightshade is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Captain. Only veterans who have demonstrated gifts for command, exceptional combat prowess, and achieved true valor in war will receive...

enemies.name: YSTF Elite Blightshade

names.es: Sombra contaminada de élite del EFEY

enemies.summary:
YSTF Elite Blightshade is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Elite. An Yinglung who has mastered both the Originium Arts and swordmancy will be considered an elite.

enemies.name: YSTF Glaiver Blightshade

names.es: Sombra contaminada con guja del EFEY

enemies.summary:
YSTF Glaiver Blightshade is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Glaiver. Such Yinglungs are extremely skilled in leading assaults and taking defended positions. The glaives they wield are designed to...

enemies.name: YSTF Vanguard Blightshade

names.es: Sombra contaminada de vanguardia del EFEY

enemies.summary:
YSTF Vanguard Blightshade is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Vanguard. Mastering melee combat techniques is just the most basic requirement for the Yinglungs.
